body.heading: Where in the world is Mali?
paragraphs: Mali is a country in Western Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Mali is Bamako.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Mali is French.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Mali is the West African CFA franc. The CFA franc is shared with neighbouring countries, so the same money works across the region.

body.heading: How big is Mali?
paragraphs: Mali covers about 1,240,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of South Sudan.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Djenné's Great Mosque is the largest mud-brick building in the world, with wooden beams poking out like a giant sandcastle. Every year the whole town replasters it in a joyful festival.
Dogon villages cling to a towering sandstone cliff, with granaries, masks and stories woven into daily life — one of West Africa's most remarkable landscapes.
